main_body: A 4x3 ground patch of green grass: a repeating 16px motif of light-green tufts and dark-green shadow blobs on a mid-green base, with small orange dots.
top_band: none. This is a flat ground texture, not a standing object. The column scan shows only a repeating 12-row mid-green and 4-row dark-green pattern.
evidence: The kind is terrain, so the standing-object 3/4 contract (top band plus front face) does not apply. The image is a seamless ground tile with no standing volume. It shows no front elevation, side elevation, top-down slab or rim-only problem, and no receding side faces.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 6 distinct colours in total and a median of 6 per tile. The grass reference has 80 colours and a median of 26 per tile. The ground ramp is only about 4 greens (dark, mid, light, highlight), plus the orange dots. Flat-fill coverage is 0%, and the dark edge pixels are tinted (0% neutral), so there is no sticker outline. The mid-green base is a nearly uniform field. The same tuft motif repeats identically every 16px, which makes an obvious grid, and there is little grain or soil variation. Next to the rich grass reference it looks much thinner and more mechanical.
